# Operator kits - demo implementation

*Generated by `Demo/BoldInBeautyDemo/Tools/gen_kit_docs.py` from the kit data; do not edit by hand.*

Every operator has a regular attack (M1), three standard moves, one independent Special and one Ultimate (MAIN section 6). Only 5-6 star operators have
passives (1-4); 3-4 star operators have none. Luna, Judge and Narrator are written by hand in Unreal (`BIBKitLuna/Judge/Narrator.cpp`, owner files);
the 17 operators below are data (`BIBRules/BIBKitData*.cpp`) run by `BIB::Kits::FRuntime`.

Source labels: **SOURCE (owner)** = written by the owner (Notion operator pages); **PROPOSED** = designed by the assistant on 2026-10-04 from the
owner's playstyle notes (owner decides: keep, change or reject); **PLACEHOLDER** = a value the demo needs that the owner has not decided.
Cooldowns, damage numbers, radii and durations of PROPOSED and PLACEHOLDER entries are balance starting points, not decisions.
